rules.accepted_credit_types: At least 15 of the 30 CCUs from Category A: in-person or live interactive (audio and video) courses approved or sponsored by APTA, an APTA state chapter or FSBPT; courses accredited by the Wyoming Departments of Education or Health may be accepted if directly related to physical therapy. Other activities may count as Category B (Chapter 6). The Board does not pre-approve courses.
rules.carryover: No carryover of CCUs to the next reporting period.
rules.audit_note: Renewal includes the Board's Statement of Continuing Competency Units itemizing each activity (date, category, sponsor, hours) plus a passing jurisprudence exam; additional documentation on request.

topics.who: Wyoming jurisprudence examination passed (score at least 75%) every two years, in addition to the 30 CCUs; can be taken online on the Board website

rules.legal_basis: Wyo. Board of Physical Therapy Rules Ch. 3 §4 (eff. 05/20/2026) and Ch. 6; Ch. 5 fees
rules.notes: Licenses are renewed annually by October 1; the 30 CCUs and the jurisprudence exam are due every two years (current cycle: courses taken October 2, 2024 - October 1, 2026). The Board states CE in continuing competence units (CCUs) and its form treats them as hours (Total hours submitted). Annual renewal fee PT $100, PTA $75 (Ch. 5, eff. 05/20/2026).
rules.rule_quote: (c) Renewal of a license or certificate shall include: (i) The successful completion of thirty (30) continuing competence units, including successful completion of the jurisprudence examination every two years;
